Их включают в настройках телефона: Sprou: Turn them on in the phone’s Settings: Sprout → Notifications.
На телефоне нет ни Face ID, ни код-парол: This phone has neither Face ID nor a passcode.
Sprout не собирает о вас никаких сведени: Sprout collects no information about you and sends nothing anywhere.
Клички растений, виды, влажность, даты —: Plant nicknames, species, moisture, dates — everything you enter is kept in a file inside the app, on the phone itself. So are the settings. None of it leaves the device.
Приложение не выходит в интернет. У него: The app never goes online. It has no account, no server, no analytics and no ads.
Наклон телефона чуть двигает узор на фон: Tilting the phone gently moves the background pattern. The readings are used only for that, aren’t saved and go nowhere.
Напоминания о поливе создаёт сам телефон: Watering reminders are created by the phone itself, from schedules calculated on it. No push server is involved.
Файл сада попадает в резервную копию iPh: The garden file goes into your iPhone backup — together with the rest of your data, under Apple’s rules.
Удалите приложение — вместе с ним исчезн: Delete the app — and everything it remembered disappears with it.
Час сада проходит здесь за секунду насто: An hour of garden time passes here in one real second: otherwise the moisture percentages wouldn’t budge in a single session. Reminders run on the same clock.
